mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, category, brand, rating, quantity, image,active) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{category}, #{brand}, #{rating}, #{quantity}, #{image},true)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM products WHERE active = true
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, category = #{category}, brand = #{brand}, rating = #{rating}, quantity = #{quantity}, image = #{image} WHERE id = #{id}
